consequence.statement: Karpenter now uses a multizone deployment by default, so controller pods may be placed differently than before.
consequence.remediation: Check how the Karpenter controller pods are spread across zones after the upgrade, and make sure the cluster has nodes in more than one zone that can run them.

assertion.statement: In Karpenter 1.0.0, the Karpenter controller deployment is spread across multiple zones by default.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The release note does not name the Helm value or deployment field that controls the multizone default.; applicability: No values key or field is named, so no condition can tell which environments get the new default and which have overridden it.
